stage.quote: On March 24, 2021, DigitalOcean became a publicly traded company on the New York Stock Exchange, with their initial public offering price at $47 per share.
stage.note: IPO'd on NYSE (DOCN) March 24, 2021; prior VC rounds (seed through series B plus debt facilities) are now superseded by public-market status.

accelerators.name: Techstars
accelerators.quote: listed in the Techstars portfolio as "DigitalOcean"

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of disclosed equity rounds per Wikipedia: $3.2M seed (2013) + $37.2M series A (2014) + $83M series B (2015) + $50M additional raise (2020) = $173.4M equity; plus $50M debt (2014) not typically counted as funding. Figure here ($223.2M) is equity+the 2014 debt facility combined and is only a rough aggregate since not confirmed by a single primary source as a cumulative total; excludes the 2016 $130M credit facility and 2026 $800M stock offering (post-IPO, not private funding).
total_funding_usd.quote: The company's seed funding was led by IA Ventures and raised US$3.2 million in July 2013. Its series A round of funding in March 2014... raised US$37.2 million... the company raised US$83 million in its series B round of funding led by Access Industries... In May 2020, DigitalOcean raised an additional $50 million from Access Industries and Andreessen Horowitz.

last_round.quote: In March 2026, DigitalOcean upsized stock offering to $800 million to fund its AI and infrastructure growth.

revenue.basis: Company-reported figure per Wikipedia infobox citing DigitalOcean's FY2023 earnings/10-K.

note: DigitalOcean is a publicly traded company (NYSE: DOCN since March 2021); pricing card products modeled here (Droplets VMs and the Managed Agents/Harness Runtime sandbox preview) are offerings of this single public company, not a separate subsidiary. Revenue figure is company-wide FY2023 ($692.9M); more recent (FY2024/FY2025) figures were not retrieved within the research window because ir.digitalocean.com was behind a Cloudflare bot-challenge.
